PROGRAM _CYCLIC
ABR1_4X_PULSE_CALC = ABR1_4X_PULSE

ENDIF

Enable = 1
ENDIF
IF ((CURRENT_LENGTH <=0.1) AND (ABR1_4X_PULSE < 0) AND (EDGEPOS(M1500))) THEN
Enable = 1
ENDIF
IF ((DI_GH_BOTTOM_PROXIMITY) AND (CURRENT_LENGTH <=0.1) AND (EDGEPOS(M1500))) THEN
Reset_3 = TRUE
HSCPF = 0
ABR1_4X = 0
ABR1_1X = 0
ABR1_4X_PULSE = 0
ABR1_4X_PULSE_CALC = 0
ELSE
Reset_3 = FALSE
ENDIF
IF EDGEPOS (Reset_3) THEN
Enable = TRUE
ENDIF
IF((DO_RESET_Y = 1) AND (DI_GH_BOTTOM_PROXIMITY) AND (Y26)) THEN
HSCPF = 0
ABR1_4X = 0
ABR1_1X = 0
ABR1_4X_PULSE = 0
ABR1_4X_PULSE_CALC = 0
ELSE
IF (ABR1_4X_PULSE_CALC >= HSCPF) THEN
ABR1_4X = ABR1_4X + (ABR1_4X_PULSE_CALC - HSCPF)
ELSE
ABR1_4X = ABR1_4X - (HSCPF - ABR1_4X_PULSE_CALC)
ENDIF
;Y AXIS
;ABR1_4X FROM THE ENCODER MODULE
;ABR1_1X TAKE IT FOR CALCULATION
IF ((ABR1_4X MOD 4) = 0) THEN
ABR1_1X = ((ABR1_4X - (ABR1_4X MOD 4)) / 4)
ELSE
ABR1_1X = ((ABR1_4X - (ABR1_4X MOD 4)) / 4) + 1
ENDIF
GUIDE_HEAD_TOP_POSITION = ABR1_1X
HSCPF = ABR1_4X_PULSE_CALC
ENDIF
ENCODER_VALUE = ABR1_1X
IF ((CURRENT_LENGTH > 0) AND (CURRENT_LENGTH <=D300) AND (ABR1_4X_PULSE=0) AND (ABR1_4X=0) AND (ABR1_1X =0)) THEN
POWER_FAIL = 1
ENDIF
IF ((EDGENEG(M1500)) AND (M1111 = 0) AND (LAP_DISC_CLOSE_ENABLE = 0) AND (M699 = 0) AND (M1600 = 0) AND (CYLINDER_LOAD <>0) AND ((CURRENT_LENGTH > 0.5) AND (CURRENT_LENGTH <= DOFF_LENGTH_MINUS_TWO))) THEN
MACHINE_STOPPED = 1
ABR1_1X_WHILE_MC_STOP = ABR1_1X
CYLINDER_LOAD_WHILE_MC_STOP = CYLINDER_LOAD
ENDIF
IF ((MACHINE_STOPPED) AND (EDGEPOS(M1500)) AND (M1600 = 0)) THEN
MACHINE_STARTED = 1
CYLINDER_LOAD_WHILE_MC_STOP = CYLINDER_LOAD
MACHINE_STOPPED = 0
ENDIF
IF (M1111 OR M699 OR M1600) THEN
MACHINE_STOPPED = 0
MACHINE_STARTED = 0
ENDIF
IF ((MACHINE_STARTED) AND (ABR1_1X > ABR1_1X_WHILE_MC_STOP)) THEN
MACHINE_STARTED = 0
MACHINE_STOPPED = 0
ENDIF
IF ((MACHINE_STARTED) OR (MACHINE_STOPPED)) THEN
CYLINDER_LOAD_ANALOG = INT (CYLINDER_LOAD_WHILE_MC_STOP * 3399)
ENDIF
IF Load_curve_selection_HMI=0 THEN
N = ABR1_1X
LH20_Load_Curve_V = 0
LH15_Load_Curve_V = 1
LH20_Load_Curve_Enc_Pulse = 1
ENDIF
IF (Load_curve_selection_HMI = 1) THEN
N = (INT(CURRENT_LENGTH))
LH20_Load_Curve_V = 0
LH15_Load_Curve_V = 1
LH20_Load_Curve_Ct_Length = 1
ENDIF
IF Load_curve_selection_HMI=2 THEN
Load_curve_selection = 1
LH20_Load_Curve_V = 1
LH15_Load_Curve_V = 0
ELSE
Load_curve_selection = 0
ENDIF
IF ((EDGEPOS(LH20_Load_Curve_Enc_Pulse)) AND (LC_Enc_Pul_Values_Updated = 0)) THEN
LH20_Load_Curve_Ct_Length = 0
C_HMI = 0
M_HMI = 5
H_HMI = -4.5
SP_HMI = 40
IL_HMI = 0.9
LC_Enc_Pul_Values_Updated = 1
ENDIF
IF ((EDGEPOS(LH20_Load_Curve_Ct_Length)) AND (LC_Len_Pul_Values_Updated = 0)) THEN
LH20_Load_Curve_Enc_Pulse = 0
C_HMI = 0
M_HMI = 0.1
H_HMI = -5.0
SP_HMI = 40
IL_HMI = 0.9
LC_Len_Pul_Values_Updated = 1
ENDIF
START_PRESSURE = D1154
C = C_HMI
M = M_HMI
H = H_HMI
temp1 = (70+C)
temp2 = (temp1/10000000)
F = (M*temp2)
P = (4.9+WINDING_INDEX+H)/1000
SP=SP_HMI
IL=IL_HMI
;	SV_TEMP=(((START_PRESSURE-IL)*N)/SP)
SV_TEMP=(((START_PRESSURE-IL)*REAL(N))/SP)
SV_TEMP1=(SV_TEMP-(START_PRESSURE-IL))
SV=SV_TEMP1
IF N>SP THEN
SV=0
ENDIF
IF ((GH_MOVING_UP = 0) AND (GH_MOVING_DOWN = 0) AND (Enable = 0) AND (A_GH_ENCODER_PULSE_MISSING = 0) AND (MACHINE_STARTED = 0) AND (MACHINE_STOPPED = 0) AND (Y1=0) AND (GH_load_test=0)) THEN
CYLINDER_LOAD = (F*(REAL(N*N))) + (P*REAL(N)) + START_PRESSURE+SV
;		CYLINDER_LOAD = ((F*N*N) + (P*N) + START_PRESSURE+SV)
CYLINDER_LOAD_ANALOG = INT (CYLINDER_LOAD * 3399)
NO_CYLINDER_LOAD_1:=1
ELSE
NO_CYLINDER_LOAD_1:=0
ENDIF
IF (GH_MOVING_DOWN = 1) THEN
CYLINDER_LOAD = 6.0
CYLINDER_LOAD_ANALOG = INT (CYLINDER_LOAD * 3399)
ENDIF
IF (GH_MOVING_UP = 1) THEN
CYLINDER_LOAD = 4.0
CYLINDER_LOAD_ANALOG = INT (CYLINDER_LOAD * 3399)
ENDIF
IF CYLINDER_LOAD>6 THEN
CYLINDER_LOAD = 6.0
CYLINDER_LOAD_ANALOG = INT (CYLINDER_LOAD * 3399)
ENDIF
IF ABR1_1X>480 THEN
ABR1_1X=480
ENDIF
IF (Enable) THEN
DELAY.IN= TRUE
ELSE
DELAY.IN= FALSE
ENDIF
DELAY.PT= T#3S
IF ((DELAY.ET > TIME(1000)) OR (Enable)) THEN
Reset1_Code = 195
DO_RESET_Y = 1
HSCPF = 0
ABR1_4X = 0
ABR1_1X = 0
ABR1_4X_PULSE = 0
ABR1_4X_PULSE_CALC = 0
ENDIF
IF ((DELAY.ET > TIME(2000)) AND (DO_LAP_DISC_FORWARD) AND (X6 OR X42)) OR (DO_RESET_Y_Status) THEN
DO_RESET_Y = 0
Reset1_Code = 0
Enable = 0
ENDIF
IF ((Enable) AND (A_GH_ENCODER_PULSE_MISSING = 0) AND (M1500 = 0) AND (M1600 = 0)) THEN
CYLINDER_LOAD = 0
CYLINDER_LOAD_ANALOG = 0
ENDIF
IF ((M1600) AND (A_GH_ENCODER_PULSE_MISSING = 0) AND (M1500 = 0) AND (Y26) AND (EDGEPOS(DI_GH_BOTTOM_PROXIMITY))) THEN
CYLINDER_LOAD = 0
CYLINDER_LOAD_ANALOG = 0
ENDIF
IF (((ABR1_1X <=0) OR (CYLINDER_LOAD_ANALOG <0)) AND (M1500) AND ((CURRENT_LENGTH > 5) AND (CURRENT_LENGTH <= DOFF_LENGTH_MINUS_TWO))) THEN
A_GH_ENCODER_PULSE_MISSING = 1
ENDIF
IF (((ABR1_1X >0) OR (CYLINDER_LOAD_ANALOG >0)) AND (M1500) AND ((CURRENT_LENGTH > 5) AND (CURRENT_LENGTH <= DOFF_LENGTH_MINUS_TWO))) THEN
A_GH_ENCODER_PULSE_MISSING = 0
ENDIF
IF ((A_GH_ENCODER_PULSE_MISSING) AND ((EDGEPOS(DI_MACHINE_INCH)) OR (EDGEPOS(DI_MACHINE_ON)) OR (EDGEPOS(DI_MACHINE_ON_TABLE_LHS)) OR (EDGEPOS(DI_MACHINE_ON_TABLE_RHS)) OR (EDGEPOS(DI_MACHINE_INCH_TABLE_LHS)) OR (EDGEPOS(DI_MACHINE_INCH_TABLE_RHS)))) THEN

ENDIF
IF (A_GH_ENCODER_PULSE_MISSING) THEN
CYLINDER_LOAD = D1154

ENDIF
IF ((CURRENT_LENGTH > 2.0) AND (CYLINDER_LOAD = 0) AND (M1500)) THEN

ENDIF
IF (EDGEPOS(M1425)) THEN
GH_PULSE = ABR1_1X
SET_BIT=1

ENDIF
IF(SET_BIT) THEN
IF(ABR1_1X>(GH_PULSE+10)) THEN
DISC_OPEN_ENABLE=1;
SET_BIT=0;
ENDIF
ENDIF
IF(ABR1_1X<(GH_PULSE+10))THEN
DISC_OPEN_ENABLE=0;
ENDIF
IF (TOP_WNDG_SAFTY_PULSE<=0) THEN
TOP_WNDG_SAFTY_PULSE =220
ENDIF
IF ((ABR1_1X >TOP_WNDG_SAFTY_PULSE) AND (M1500) AND ((CURRENT_LENGTH > 0.5) AND (CURRENT_LENGTH <= DOFF_LENGTH_MINUS_TWO)) AND ((NOT(M1111)) OR (NOT(M699)) OR (NOT(M1600)))) THEN
A_TOP_WINDING_SAFETY = 1
ENDIF
IF (EDGEPOS(M1111) OR ((A_TOP_WINDING_SAFETY) AND ((EDGEPOS(DI_MACHINE_INCH)) OR (EDGEPOS(DI_MACHINE_ON)) OR (EDGEPOS(DI_MACHINE_ON_TABLE_LHS)) OR (EDGEPOS(DI_MACHINE_INCH_TABLE_RHS)))))  THEN

ENDIF
IF ((M1600) AND (M1500 = 0) AND (Y2 = 0) AND (EDGEPOS(M1425))) THEN

IF ((M1600) AND (EDGENEG(GH_UP_ENABLE)) AND (A_GH_ENCODER_PULSE_MISSING = 0) AND (MACHINE_STARTED = 0) AND (MACHINE_STOPPED = 0) AND (Y1=0)) THEN

ENDIF
IF ((M1600 = 0) AND (Y25) AND (EDGEPOS(GH_TOP_POSITION_REACHED))) THEN

ENDIF
IF ((M1600 = 0) AND (M1111 OR M699) AND (Y25 = 0) AND (Y26) AND (ABR1_1X <= GH_ENC_PULSE_GH_TOP)) THEN
SPOOL_CHANGER_ENABLE_GH_DOWN = 1
ENDIF
IF ((M1600 = 0) AND (SPOOL_CHANGER_ENABLE_GH_DOWN) AND (EDGEPOS(DO_SPOOL_CHANGER_REVERSE))) THEN
SPOOL_CHANGER_ENABLE_GH_DOWN = 0
ENDIF
